dialogues.title: First Day at School
dialogues.description: A new student meets her teacher on the first day.

lines.text: Good morning! You must be Maria, our new student.
lines.translation: Good morning! You must be Maria, our new student.

lines.text: Yes, that's right. Nice to meet you.
lines.translation: Yes, that's right. Nice to meet you.

lines.text: Welcome! Your seat is next to the window.
lines.translation: Welcome! Your seat is next to the window.

lines.text: Thank you. Where should I put my bag?
lines.translation: Thank you. Where should I put my bag?

lines.text: You can hang it on the hook by the door.
lines.translation: You can hang it on the hook by the door.

dialogues.title: Doctor's Appointment
dialogues.description: A patient describes his symptoms to the doctor.

lines.text: Good morning, Tom. What brings you in today?
lines.translation: Good morning, Tom. What brings you in today?

lines.text: I've had a sore throat and a slight fever since yesterday.
lines.translation: I've had a sore throat and a slight fever since yesterday.

lines.text: I see. Have you been drinking enough water?
lines.translation: I see. Have you been drinking enough water?

lines.text: Not really, I've been quite busy with work.
lines.translation: Not really, I've been quite busy with work.

lines.text: Try to rest and stay hydrated. I'll prescribe something for the throat.
lines.translation: Try to rest and stay hydrated. I'll prescribe something for the throat.

lines.text: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.
lines.translation: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.

dialogues.title: Job Interview
dialogues.description: A candidate answers behavioral interview questions.

lines.text: So, Sarah, what would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.translation: So, Sarah, what would you say is your greatest strength?

lines.text: I'd say my ability to stay calm under pressure and prioritize effectively.
lines.translation: I'd say my ability to stay calm under pressure and prioritize effectively.

lines.text: Could you give an example of a time that was tested?
lines.translation: Could you give an example of a time that was tested?

lines.text: During a product launch, two systems failed simultaneously, and I coordinated the team to resolve both within the hour.
lines.translation: During a product launch, two systems failed simultaneously, and I coordinated the team to resolve both within the hour.

lines.text: Impressive. How do you handle disagreements with colleagues?
lines.translation: Impressive. How do you handle disagreements with colleagues?

lines.text: I try to understand their perspective first, then find common ground before proposing a solution.
lines.translation: I try to understand their perspective first, then find common ground before proposing a solution.
